body: Production 2D SpriteKit game asset sheet, EXACTLY FOUR isolated objects in a 2 by 2 grid, true transparent background, no grid lines, no text, no panels. Use ONLY the magic BOOK design in the left column of the reference; ignore robot/teapot. Match its indigo-purple leather covers, chunky gold corners and gold star engravings, turquoise diamond gemstone on the central spine, cream paper, same 3/4 side view with the open page seam aiming RIGHT. Polished hand-painted cartoon game sprites, strong dark silhouette edges, suitable at 80px height, coherent upper-left lighting. TOP LEFT cell: one complete clean open spellbook base, all parts visible, with thick cream pages in a modest low open position; NO floating stars, NO orbit, NO magical flames, NO ground shadow. The gem/spine hinge is at lower center. This is the stable base and portrait. TOP RIGHT cell: one detached fan of 3–4 cream LEFT book pages, a triangular curved stack extending UP and LEFT from a hinge at its LOWER RIGHT, lightly engraved violet lines, exactly matching the book view; no cover, no gem, no book underneath. BOTTOM LEFT cell: one detached fan of 3–4 cream RIGHT book pages, a curved triangular stack extending UP and RIGHT from a hinge at its LOWER LEFT, exactly matching the book view; no cover or book underneath. These two detached page fans will overlap the complete base for subtle articulated page movement. BOTTOM RIGHT cell: one violet-blue round STAR PEARL projectile, bright solid spherical glass-like body containing a golden four-point star, a single thin tilted golden orbital ring around it; NO trailing ribbons and NO detached sparkles, centered isolated asset. Every object entirely inside its own quadrant, large TRANSPARENT gutters, 12% transparent padding per cell, zero overlap, no crops. Background is genuinely transparent with usable alpha, not a painted black or checkerboard backdrop. No typography, no logos, no extra objects.
effects: Create a transparent 2D game VFX asset sheet for an indigo spellbook: EXACTLY SIX separate effects arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, ample invisible gutters and 12% empty padding inside each equal cell. True transparent alpha background, no painted background, no checkerboard, no labels/text/logos. Cohesive polished cartoon fantasy game style, crisp substantial silhouettes, violet-blue energy, bright cream-gold four-point stars and thin golden edges, readable on bright green grass. Preserve hollow transparent centers where appropriate. TOP LEFT: a single horizontal flowing DOUBLE RIBBON TRAIL, tapering to the LEFT and with a small bright knot at the RIGHT, violet and cyan blue ribbons curling around each other, no projectile orb. TOP MIDDLE: a single golden FOUR-POINT STAR sparkle, thick cream gold center and sharp tapered rays, subtle violet outer glow, very few details, isolated. TOP RIGHT: an empty STAR GATE RING, thin but substantial gold circle with four larger four-point golden stars at cardinal directions, violet-blue inner glow, completely hollow transparent central area, NO orb inside. BOTTOM LEFT: a single curved violet-gold CRESCENT LAUNCH ARC, tapered tips, no orb or projectile, fluid and compact. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a single energetic IMPACT STAR, asymmetric eight-point gold-white burst with purple outer spikes, opaque strong core, no circular cloud. BOTTOM RIGHT: a complete CONSTELLATION HALO made of five small golden star points connected by fine violet light strokes, open irregular pentagon, hollow transparent middle. No book, no scene, no particles outside cell boundaries. Effects kept entirely separate and fully inside cells for deterministic slicing. These are game runtime sprite textures, not a concept presentation.
